sentences.en: I know how stressful that kind of situation can be.
sentences.zh: 我知道那种情况有多大的压力。

sentences.en: Going to the grocery store has become a stressful experience.
sentences.zh: 去超市已经成为一种令人紧张的经历。

sentences.en: Entry level jobs in telesales are usually stressful and low-paying.
sentences.zh: 电信销售行业的入门级工作通常既紧张又收入不高。

senses.zh: (状况、经历) 压力大的，令人紧张的
